imu_motion_noise.model: independent isotropic Gaussian acceleration samples; supplied attitude/times fixed; no bias/attitude/timing uncertainty

motion_estimation.method: piecewise-linear acceleration integrated exactly per segment; quaternion SLERP
motion_estimation.attitude_source: supplied body-to-ENU quaternion, not an estimated AHRS
motion_estimation.uncertainty_model: per-axis temporal covariance of independent isotropic white acceleration samples; conditioned on supplied attitude/times; no bias/attitude/timing/integration-error covariance
motion_estimation.drift_policy: zero initialization per window; no truth velocity, bias correction or high-pass filter; polynomial nuisance projection handles low-order drift
